groups.name: Start here
groups.blurb: Small Beginner warm-ups to learn Masyu, Slitherlink, Mid-loop, and Hamilton cycle.

groups.name: Masyu
groups.blurb: Classic Masyu by size, plus Gray dots, Swiss cheese, and Bonus themes.

Classic.blurb: Standard Masyu boards by size, from 8×8 up to full-page 16×24.

8×8.blurb: Compact boards across all four difficulties.

12×12.blurb: Classic boards across all four difficulties.

16×16.blurb: Big square boards across all four difficulties.

12×20.blurb: Tall magazine-page boards across all four difficulties.

16×24.blurb: Full-page 2:3 boards across all four difficulties.

Gray dots.blurb: Gray circles are secretly either white or black — figuring out which is part of the puzzle (tap any gray circle to label it).

Swiss cheese.blurb: Boards punched with random interior holes across four sizes — each hole is entirely Inside or Outside the loop.

Bonus.blurb: Themed variations with the same Masyu rules.

groups.name: Slitherlink
groups.blurb: Each numbered square tells how many of its four sides belong to the single closed loop.

groups.name: Mid-loop
groups.blurb: Pass straight through every teal dot at the exact midpoint of its straight loop segment.

groups.name: Hamilton cycle
groups.blurb: Visit every single dot on the grid — guided by given lines, given walls, or both.

groups.name: Hybrids
groups.blurb: Two loop puzzle rules combined on one board — every puzzle genuinely needs both.

Masyu + Hamilton cycle.blurb: Masyu circles on a loop that must visit every dot on the grid.

Slitherlink + Masyu.blurb: Numbered squares and Masyu circles sharing one single closed loop.

Slitherlink + Hamilton cycle.blurb: Slitherlink numbers on a Hamilton cycle that visits every single dot.

Mid-loop + Masyu.blurb: Teal midpoint dots and Masyu circles sharing one single closed loop.

Mid-loop + Slitherlink.blurb: Teal midpoint dots and numbered Slitherlink squares sharing one single closed loop.

Mid-loop + Hamilton cycle.blurb: Teal midpoint dots on a Hamilton cycle that visits every single dot.
